program_name: Experimental optical knowledge borrowing for molecular photocatalysis
status: retrospective design frozen after the source and target papers and file schemas were inspected; no cross-database model was fitted and no aggregate target-outcome analysis was performed before this freeze
purpose: Test whether experimentally learned molecular optical properties repair prediction and ranking in chemically distant, data-poor regions of an independently measured molecular photocatalysis programme.
scientific_hypothesis: For an organic molecular photocatalyst, externally learned light-absorption and excited-state behavior supplies mechanistically adjacent information that is not fully recoverable from a small recipient-only structure-activity dataset. The benefit should concentrate in recipient regions with sparse target labels but adequate optical-source support.
claim_guard: A positive result would establish a retrospective experimental-database borrowing edge from molecular optical spectroscopy to molecular photocatalytic hydrogen evolution. It would not establish prospective laboratory discovery, a universal benefit of optical descriptors, or transfer to inorganic photocatalysts. A null or harmful result remains in the borrowing map.

source.declared_grain: one chromophore-solvent or chromophore-solid-state experimental optical record
source.source_state_policy: The primary donor target for each property is the per-chromophore median across reported environments. Water, methanol, alcohol-family, and solid-state subsets are prespecified sensitivities because the recipient uses a triethylamine-methanol-water mixture and suspended molecular solids.
source.direct_entity_exclusion: Every canonical recipient molecule is removed from donor training before any donor model is fitted.
source.near_neighbor_sensitivity: A separate strict sensitivity removes donor molecules with Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto similarity at least 0.95 to any recipient molecule; this cannot replace the exact-entity-excluded primary analysis.

target.declared_grain: one experimentally tested aromatic molecule under the common sacrificial hydrogen-evolution protocol
target.development_use: The 572-molecule library is the only target-outcome set available for recipient model fitting, nested admission, and method selection.
target.blind_use: The published 96-molecule blind set is locked for one final evaluation after donor-property admission and model choices are frozen from the development set.
target.blind_outcome_sentinel: No blind HER value may be joined to features until a blind-release manifest hashes the selected donor features, model settings, target label-budget draws, OOD scopes, controls, and analysis code.

outcome_independent_audit.structure_standardization: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES after sanitization; no tautomer standardization in the primary audit
outcome_independent_audit.scaffold: Bemis-Murcko canonical scaffold; acyclic molecules receive a deterministic acyclic scaffold label
outcome_independent_audit.ood_distance: one minus maximum Morgan Tanimoto similarity to the eligible target-development molecules
outcome_independent_audit.primary_ood_scope: the 40 percent of blind molecules with the lowest maximum similarity to target development, with ties broken by canonical-SMILES hash
outcome_independent_audit.secondary_ood_scope: the 25 percent of blind molecules with the lowest maximum similarity to target development
outcome_independent_audit.source_support: maximum Morgan Tanimoto similarity to exact-recipient-excluded donor molecules plus donor ensemble uncertainty

donor_modeling.representation: Morgan fingerprint of the chromophore; solvent is not used in the primary per-molecule-median donor model
donor_modeling.validation: five-fold canonical-scaffold grouped cross-validation with all records for a chromophore kept together
donor_modeling.prediction_vector: one prediction and one ensemble uncertainty per admitted optical property
donor_modeling.abstention: No optical property failing its donor-only skill gate can enter the recipient model.

recipient_modeling.target_representation: Morgan fingerprint with radius 2 and 2048 bits
recipient_modeling.budget_sampling: 100 deterministic scaffold-group draws made without target outcomes; all model comparisons share the same draws
recipient_modeling.nested_development_admission: Within the 572-molecule development set, admitted donor properties are retained as a single prespecified vector only if scaffold-group cross-validation at the primary label budget improves log1p-HER RMSE by at least 2 percent versus target-only and exceeds the matched shuffled-vector median. The 96 blind outcomes cannot influence this decision.
feature_forms: raw admitted donor predictions and uncertainties
rank-normalized admitted donor predictions and uncertainties
recipient_modeling.feature_form_selection: select once by nested development performance, then freeze before blind release

required: published target-side calculated electronic descriptors only plus target structure
admitted donor optical vector plus target structure
admitted donor optical vector plus published calculated descriptors plus target structure
column-wise shuffled admitted donor vector plus target structure
equal-dimensional Gaussian random feature vector plus target structure
baselines_and_controls.wrong_domain_control: A molecular melting-point donor prediction is a prespecified secondary wrong-domain control if its independently versioned open dataset passes the same source-only skill and coverage gates.
baselines_and_controls.lookup_upper_bound: Direct optical measurements for exact recipient molecules, when present, may be reported only as a labeled real-world lookup upper bound and never as the strict-transfer primary result.

endpoints.primary: paired relative reduction in log1p-HER RMSE versus target-only in the frozen hard-OOD 40 percent of the 96-molecule blind set at target label budget 60
endpoints.required_absolute_utility: positive donor-augmented R2 in the primary blind OOD scope
secondary_prediction: calibration of donor-support and prediction uncertainty
secondary_exploration: high-activity enrichment among the top 5, 10, and 20 ranked blind molecules
experiments required to recover 25 and 50 percent of high-activity blind molecules

inference.resampling_unit: Bemis-Murcko scaffold in the blind set
inference.paired_test: paired scaffold-cluster bootstrap and paired scaffold-sign randomization where evaluable
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction over three named primary-family contrasts: donor versus target-only, donor versus shuffled donor, and donor-plus-calculated versus calculated-only
inference.reporting: Report every frozen baseline, control, label budget, OOD scope, and admitted or rejected optical property. Do not replace a failed primary endpoint with a favorable secondary endpoint.

leakage_exclusions: canonical recipient molecule from donor training
recipient article DOI or supplementary record from donor provenance
blind HER values from all development, feature selection, source admission, and hyperparameter decisions
blind membership from label-budget selection except for the already published fixed split
same canonical scaffold crossing a resampling unit
audit_sentinels: verify exact source and target file hashes before parsing
save a no-outcome target metadata table containing split, canonical structure, scaffold, OOD distance, and source support
hash donor out-of-fold predictions and donor admission decisions
hash development-only target label-budget draws and nested admission results
write and hash a blind-release manifest before joining blind HER values
verify that permuting blind outcomes cannot change features, scopes, admissions, or model settings
archive positive, null, harmful, and abstaining outcomes in the knowledge-borrowing map
